Name: Take a Break
Author: Krutonium
Description:
This mod makes it so that when you stand in place and do nothing, your health and energy regenerate. This is helpful if you've run out of energy in the mines or the fields. It's a bit lower than going to the bath house or eating food, and does make you vulnerable to attacks (since you can't swing your sword either.)

Created Live on [url=http://twitch.tv/PFCKrutonium]Twitch[/url][img]https://i.imgur.com/jP5INXH.png[/img]﻿(Ugh it's huge)

Downloads.Description: Fix a bug where it was possible to gain infinite health by decreasing it by an odd number.

Manifest.Name: TakeABreak
Manifest.Description: Standing Still refills your stamina and health!
